verdict.rationale: Finix documents its own recurring, scheduled operations within the payments domain: Subscriptions for recurring billing and configurable payout schedules. Report generation is also described as automated. These are fixed, domain-specific schedules rather than general user-defined recurring jobs or workflows, and the evidence is a thin one-line mention for each. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, API or agent-driven schedule management, documented schedule configuration details (cadence, cron-like control), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Bill your customers and buyers using Finix's Subscriptions.
more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
